Hi Alyssa — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and three asks so we can map approvals and get a pilot signed: 

Call recap (30 min):
- Goal: 6-week LLM inference pilot to evaluate latency, cost, and integration with Silverline's QA workflow.
- Key success metrics you shared: 95th-pctl token latency <= 120ms, per-token cost target < $0.0015, and evidence of SOC2 + SSO compatibility.
- Technical note: we can run the pilot in a VPC-backed private deployment and provide a temporary dedicated pool for consistent latency.

Asks / next steps: 
1) Stakeholder roster: can you share a short list of people we should loop in for sign-off (economic buyer, procurement lead, security/contact for vendor assessment, and the integration owner)? a simple name + title + email will do.
2) Decision criteria: please confirm any mandatory gating items (procurement playbook steps, legal SLA minimums, SOC2 or audit evidence).
3) Intro request: if possible, please introduce us to the person who owns the budget and the security reviewer — a 15-minute intro would be ideal.

Attachments: pilot-proposal-v1.pdf (brief scope & timeline)

Proposed next meeting: Thu 2/11 10:00–10:30 PT for a technical kickoff (we'll bring Dylan, our solutions engineer). Let me know if that works.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—

Decision criteria / gates:
